title: The coefficient change $E_X\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, $E$ a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\Qlb$, and $X$ a
scheme. The inclusion $E_X\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$ is the coefficient change ([def-sfb-coefficient-map])
on $X$ of the inclusion $\underline E\to\underline{\Qlb}$ of condensed rings
([sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], [def-sfb-qlbar-subextension-to-qlbar]), a morphism between the
pulled-back coefficient rings $E_X=p_X^*\underline E$ and $\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}=p_X^*\underline{\Qlb}$
([sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]).

lean.statement:
noncomputable abbrev padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl (E : FiniteIntermediateField ℓ) :
    padicSubfieldRingObj X ℓ E ⟶ padicAlgClRingObj X ℓ :=
lean.note: Exact existing construction in the published pro-etale framework. In the enclosing context (X : Scheme.{u}) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime], E : FiniteIntermediateField ℓ is a finite intermediate field of PadicAlgCl ℓ containing ℚ_[ℓ]. The abbreviation is coefficientMap (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl ℓ E) X, with source padicSubfieldRingObj X ℓ E = condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X and target padicAlgClRingObj X ℓ = condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) X. It is exactly the pullback along p_X of the condensed-ring inclusion E̲ → Q̲̄_ℓ specified by the node; no duplicate construction is introduced.
